objective: Measure whether deterministic stack/runtime grouping improves native file localization over a plain presentation of identical bounded observations.
hypothesis: Grouping shared source records by stack position and observed execution helps the reader discriminate relevant implementation files without adding evidence or using reference labels.
scope: All16 source-order r6 capacity cases; already exposed development, not untouched confirmation. Closure missing coverage retained in both arms.

arms.plain: Lexical path order, canonical candidate IDs, each shared record exactly once.
arms.linked: Same records and canonical candidate IDs, grouped stack-and-observed, stack-only, observed-only, other; stack positions then lexical order. Group labels and order are derived from fields also present in plain records.

candidate_policy: Existing frozen combined navigation pool intersected with all-production instrumentation rows. No reference or positive-coverage filter. Every omitted non-production navigation path recorded; max36 candidates. Both arms have identical candidates.
source_policy: Full canonical buggy Java source, matching receipts and source-tree identity. One bounded excerpt per candidate: first in-range matched stack coordinate if available; otherwise earliest maximal query-term overlap/boolean observed-line window. At most10 source lines and450 Unicode characters; partial line explicitly marked. No ranking by execution counts; same exact records in both arms.
runtime_policy: Per-file observed-execution flag and excerpt line observations only. Not-observed never means irrelevant. Missing coverage remains unavailable, not zero. Test-command phase includes build/setup JVMs; neither test-exclusive causality nor suspiciousness is established. Full coverage not delivered to the reader; omitted evidence accounted explicitly.
provider_plan: Existing VPS transport and protected credential, GLM5.3flash low reasoning; 8192-token request window, output512. All32 prompts must be tokenizer-admitted before any generations. Alternate arm order by case. No automatic retry, replay or post-freeze prompt adjustment. This source-preparation stage performs zero provider calls.
evaluation_plan: Freeze runner, decoder, scorer and all artifacts before provider dispatch; seal all32 predictions before exposed native-label scoring. Invalid, refused or missing replies remain failures in16-case denominators. Primary MRR@8 and Hit@3; record Recall@8, paired project-level significance, all strong retained source comparators and costs. Exact complete mapping for every16 case required.

development_gate.reason: A material mechanism improvement, not an availability gain; does not replace historical62-case gates or establish superiority. Three net hits are18.75pp on this small development cohort. Independent confirmation and all-in cost evaluation remain necessary.

cost_policy: Import full1125665ms original cold operation cost without amortizing away failures, plus new construction, audit, tokenizer and generation cost. Report pair/arm cost without claiming wall-clock or production efficiency; duplicated acquisition is not charged twice within a matched pair.
construction_boundary: D65 private-owner-directed candidate benchmark development; ontology records/selectors empty. No approval, admission, activation, publication or deployment follows.
open_questions: Does grouping improve quality when both arms see the same bounded records, or only reorder position bias?
Is a larger/disjoint trustworthy native population available for confirmation after development, with capacity misses retained?
What all-in quality/cost advantage survives against the strongest runtime-informed comparator?
Provider execution/scoring artifacts must be separately pinned before dispatch; prepared packets alone do not admit a quality claim.
